what: The first parallel build (24 workers) failed for the fold-1 dev jobs with a Windows paging-file error; rebuilt with 10 single-thread workers. Scenario builds are deterministic (keyed noise, keyed Monte Carlo), so the cached cells do not depend on the worker count.

Event estimates use 32 posterior profile draws per sampled outcome; the top-3 selection on noisy estimates is optimistic (selection bias) and the probabilities are unvalidated. Calibration by quintile is reported in RESULTS.json.

Agent proposal 3 (`gain`) is algebraically identical to the incumbent `la` (gain = la - ev0 with ev0 constant per compound): a no-op that consumed one of the 12 proposals. Proposals were not edited or replaced.

The first draft of the feature-leak test was vacuous (features_for takes no hidden side); replaced by a test that scrambles every non-seed cell of the hidden matrix and shows identical features but a different counterfactual table.
ap_build.py was edited once after FREEZE1 (worker count) and reverted before the held-out build; FREEZE1 matches the reverted file.

`import seal` inside the frozen ap_build.py/evaluate.py resolves to the predecessor study's seal.py (ap_task puts that study first on sys.path), which made the first held-out build fail at its freeze check before any scenario was built. The frozen files were not edited: the unhashed launcher launch.py registers this study's seal first.
effect: none on any number; no held-out outcome was read by the failed attempt
